props.text: For over fifty years we have helped students of every background find what they are good at,.
A caring primary school with small classes, big playgrounds and a love of learning.
Evening and weekend courses for working professionals.
Flexible study from anywhere, with live tutor support.
Financial support for talented students from all backgrounds.
Mentors, placements and lifelong career support.
Advanced study and research with leading academics.
For over fifty years we have helped students of every background find what they are good at, and given them the confidence to go further.
Small classes, dedicated teachers and strong links with employers mean students are known, challenged and ready for what comes next.
Applications are open. Come to an open day, or talk to our admissions team.

props.question: Can I visit before applying?
props.answer: Yes. Join an open day, or arrange a private campus tour.

props.question: Do you accept international students?
props.answer: Yes, from over forty countries, with dedicated visa support.

props.question: When do applications open?
props.answer: In September for study starting the following year. Late applications are considered if places remain.

props.question: What financial support is there?
props.answer: Scholarships, bursaries and payment plans are available. Our fees team can advise you.
